visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a pair of hands wearing silver rings holding several colorful banknotes on a wooden table. Beside the money is an orange Hermès brand box and a brown leather item. White text appears on the screen in the center. (2) The hands fan out five different colored banknotes (green, brown, purple, blue, red) and a gold foil card with ornate engravings. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from the left side, creating shadows on the table. (3) The individual proceeds to show the individual bills, starting with a green $200 bill, followed by a brown $500 bill, and then the gold foil card. Small graphic icons and text descriptions appear next to the bills. (4) The hands place the banknotes in a specific stacked order on the table according to their colors. (5) A red envelope with a gold snake pattern is shown. The gold foil card is inserted into the red envelope. (6) The hands move to the orange Hermès box, untying a brown ribbon and opening the lid to reveal a grey leather wallet wrapped in white tissue paper. (7) The tissue paper is removed to show a Hermès Bearn wallet in 'Etoupe' grey with a silver 'H' clasp. (8) The wallet is opened, and various items are placed inside: the red envelope with the 'money mother,' credit cards, access cards, business cards, a yellow 'Omamori' charm, and coins into the zippered section. (9) The wallet is closed and held up to the camera, showcasing its exterior. (10) The video ends with the person giving a 'thumbs up' gesture with one hand next to the closed wallet.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, finger-picked acoustic guitar melody in a major key. There is a light, airy indoor room tone. A 'pop' sound effect triggers as the first text graphic appears. (2) As the hands move the banknotes, the sound of paper rustling and light friction is clearly audible, synchronized with the movement of the bills. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs during a quick visual cut between bills. (4) The guitar music continues steadily as the hands untie the ribbon of the box, accompanied by a soft fabric friction sound. (5) More paper rustling is heard as the tissue paper is pulled from the box. (6) A series of 'pop' and 'click' sound effects occur as cards are slotted into the wallet pockets. (7) The video concludes with a bright 'ding' sound effect accompanying the final 'thumbs up' gesture, while the guitar melody fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides a ritualistic guide for 'attracting wealth' during the New Year by setting up a specific brand-name wallet with banknotes arranged according to the Chinese 'Five Elements' theory.
